title: When the Ghost Turns
author: X. M. Marchetti
blurb: Hazel Vane, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
